rule: The values a message the person marked secret makes secret (agent privacy.marked_values, Go withhold.MarkedValues): the message whole (without the block of files it brings, its spaces folded), the secrets its structure spells out, and each word - split on white space, the characters .,;:!?"'()[]{} trimmed from its ends - of 4 or more code points with a digit or a punctuation or symbol character in it, not words of letters joined by hyphens, that is not data by its structure: an amount or number (values.parse_amount), a date (values.parse_date), a time, an e-mail address, a URL, a host name, a contraction, or one figure over another (a ratio). Values are compared as a set.
